user_goal: Publish PLOTKEEPER at EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER with the other Slopware skills, required Codex hooks, appropriate credit to Slopware and OpenAI Codex, and a suitable open-source license.

authority.verbatim_text:
[https://github.com/EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER](https://github.com/EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER) - created.

Make sure to include the other skills from Slopware, and the codex hooks required - give both the credit, pick whatever license you think fits cleanly.

baseline.protection_evidence: Clean local main checkout with one worktree; public GitHub repository exists and is empty before publication.
baseline.selection_reason: This is the independently reviewed first-class repository candidate that predates the newly authorized integration, attribution, licensing, and publication work.

resources: GitHub main branch and repository metadata
Codex integration installer and hook configuration
semantic_changes: Add a reproducible Codex integration that installs the canonical Slopware MSW, MSW Hook, and Timebox plugins and the Plotkeeper adaptive-execution skill and hooks.
Document the exact hook trust boundary and distinguish Slopware-owned and Plotkeeper-owned behavior.
Add Apache License 2.0 for Plotkeeper-owned code and documentation plus accurate third-party notices and attribution.
Configure origin for EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER and publish the reviewed repository to its default branch.
Set accurate public repository description and topics.
Do not alter Plotkeeper runtime behavior or review-closeout semantics.
Do not vendor or relicense Slopware-owned skill text as Plotkeeper work.
Do not auto-trust Codex hooks or bypass the user's required hook inspection.
Do not publish secrets, personal data, runtime ledgers, local receipts, or Codex session material.
Do not claim OpenAI or Slopware endorsement, affiliation, or ownership.

invariants: The previously reviewed Plotkeeper package behavior and tests remain unchanged and green.
Slopware plugins are installed from transcendr/slopware-skills and retain explicit Slopware Engineer / @aienginerd attribution and CC BY 4.0 notice.
Timebox remains hook-free and durations are never invented.
The MSW Hook remains the upstream SessionStart reinforcement; Plotkeeper's UserPromptSubmit and Stop hooks are separately identified.
Hook installation never marks a hook trusted without user inspection in Codex.
The public repository contains no secrets, personal datasets, runtime ledger, or session JSONL.
The remote default branch resolves to the exact reviewed release candidate.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: A new Codex user can install MSW, MSW Hook, Timebox, Plotkeeper adaptive execution, and the required hooks from repository instructions without copying machine-specific paths.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: The installer must not silently overwrite unrelated hooks, trust hooks automatically, or claim Timebox has a hook.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Windows Codex user following the repository's integration quickstart.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: The public repository clearly credits Slopware Engineer for MSW, MSW Hook, and Timebox and credits OpenAI Codex as the host platform while distinguishing Plotkeeper-owned integration code.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: No copied upstream content is misattributed, relicensed, or presented as endorsed by OpenAI or Slopware.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Public repository reader and upstream rights holder.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Plotkeeper-owned code and documentation are released under Apache License 2.0 with machine-readable project metadata.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: The license must not purport to replace the upstream CC BY 4.0 license or cover third-party trademarks.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER publicly serves the exact independently reviewed candidate on its default branch with accurate repository metadata.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: No unreviewed SHA, unrelated diff, secret, runtime ledger, or local receipt may be published.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: GitHub visitor cloning or browsing EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER.

proof_requirements.claim: The Codex integration installer and hook merge behavior are deterministic and preserve unrelated hook configuration.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Isolated Z-drive test home with stubbed Codex plugin commands
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Run installer/verification tests against empty and pre-populated hook files.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: All three canonical Slopware packages are requested, adaptive files are installed, two Plotkeeper hooks are merged idempotently, unrelated hooks remain, and trust state is untouched.

proof_requirements.claim: Every documented hook event, command, and trust step matches the bundled installer and canonical upstream package behavior.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Cross-check README, integration guide, hook template, installer, and upstream Slopware package manifests.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: SessionStart belongs only to MSW Hook, UserPromptSubmit and Stop invoke adaptive_execution.py, and the user is told to inspect and trust all three in /hooks.

proof_requirements.claim: Attribution and third-party notices name correct owners, links, packages, and licenses without endorsement language.
proof_requirements.required_environment: Repository documentation and upstream public repository
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Compare notices and credits against transcendr/slopware-skills and official OpenAI Codex documentation.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Slopware Engineer / @aienginerd and CC BY 4.0 are explicit; OpenAI Codex is identified as the integration host with a non-endorsement statement.

proof_requirements.claim: Apache-2.0 license text is complete and project metadata declares that license without swallowing third-party notices.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Validate LICENSE text, pyproject license expression, README license section, and third-party notice separation.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Apache-2.0 is consistently declared for Plotkeeper-owned work and Slopware remains separately CC BY 4.0.

proof_requirements.claim: The complete final local diff is reviewed, tests pass, and the candidate contains no forbidden or sensitive material.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Run full tests, compilation, diff-scope review, secret-sensitive path scan, and independent production-goal review.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Required checks and independent phase receipts PASS against the exact candidate SHA.

proof_requirements.claim: The GitHub default branch, repository contents, Actions result, description, topics, and remote SHA match the reviewed release.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: Query GitHub API and clone/browse the public repository after push.
proof_requirements.expected_observation: Public default branch resolves to the reviewed SHA, required files render, metadata is accurate, and required GitHub Actions checks are not failing.

release_requirements.required_receipt: Validated candidate SHA, clean scope, authenticated EmergentKnowledgeGroup target, empty-or-expected remote baseline, and rollback command.
GitHub API attestation binding default branch SHA, repository visibility, metadata, required files, and Actions status to the deployed candidate.

stop_conditions: The local checkout or remote repository contains unexpected unrelated content.
The final diff touches forbidden runtime behavior or private Codex data.
The Slopware owner, package list, hook behavior, or license cannot be verified.
The Codex integration would overwrite unrelated hooks or auto-trust commands.
Independent review is not PASS for the exact candidate and release phase.
The authenticated GitHub owner, repository visibility, default branch, or remote baseline differs from EmergentKnowledgeGroup/PLOTKEEPER as authorized.
GitHub rejects the push or the public branch cannot be attested to the reviewed SHA.
known_discrepancies: The public GitHub repository exists but is empty and the local checkout has no origin remote.
The previous contract explicitly prohibited publication; this append-only contract records the user's new publication authority.
The repository currently has no license or third-party notices.

Official OpenAI documentation search did not expose a public Codex hook schema page; hook event details will therefore be bound to the installed Codex hook surface and upstream Slopware manifests, with that limitation disclosed.

requirement_trace.user_requirement: include the other skills from Slopware
